scope: Approach camera correction after operator feedback; arrival success does not qualify camera quality
reported_live_issue: Repeated travel-heading / chest-heading rotation was janky
construction: Maintain a target-facing camera using normal forward/back/left/right combinations for the same intended world movement direction.
Native Minecraft retains diagonal normalization, acceleration, collision and damage authority.
Camera commands use shortest-arc yaw and at most eight degrees per axis; larger turn stages have no movement and re-observe navigation/visibility before resuming.
Re-observe the selected target after each movement pulse without a forced turn-back; actor/deadline/cancel/hazard and exact native success checks remain.
Default autopilot forward-facing behavior is unchanged.

checks.native_input_bytecode_inspection: Minecraft 26.3 KeyboardInput.tick constructs a Vec2 and calls normalized; ClientInput exposes getMoveVector

qualification: Component/algebra regression checks TESTED; graphical camera quality UNVERIFIED
limits: Native-style key-direction algebra is not full gameplay or modpack qualification.
Eight-degree command bounds do not guarantee pixel smoothness under arbitrary frame rates, latency or human mouse input.
Earlier one-chest arrival PASS and the centering failure remain recorded separately.
No physics override, reach extension, trust change, inventory action or publication approval.
